{{Top|leg}}
'''Surge of the Brier''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] technique, similar to [[Plant Surge]], that had the user reach into the [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|spirit realm]] and grip the essence of a sessile [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. The technique's wielder could twist and shape the plant into a form of their choosing, and by doing so could wrap an enemy in vines, or impale them with thorns.<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> It was similar to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] known as [[Plant Surge|''Consitor Sato'']].<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

The Nightsister's believed that the invocation of "green spirits" could also generate a "calming aura of meditation" or break down poisons that had infected the bloodstream.<ref name="BOS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Daniel Wallace]], author of the ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', compared this ability with powers of [[Wikipedia:Batman|Batman]] villain [[Wikipedia:Poison Ivy (comics)|Poison Ivy]].<ref name="BOS endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/04/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 4)}}</ref>
